operators.name: softmax_dim1_forward
semantics: Computes softmax along dim=1 for a 4D float32 tensor.
For each (n, h, w), output[n, c, h, w] = exp(x[n, c, h, w] - max_c x[n, c, h, w]) / sum_c exp(x[n, c, h, w] - max_c x[n, c, h, w]).
Handles arbitrary strides; input is not required to be contiguous.
The custom op preserves dtype, device, shape, and stride of the input tensor as specified by PyTorch softmax semantics.
No in-place modification; returns a newly allocated tensor.

operators.name: hardtanh_forward
semantics: Applies hardtanh element-wise: output = clamp(x, min_val=-1.0, max_val=1.0).
Equivalent to F.hardtanh(x) with default parameters.
Preserves dtype, device, shape, and stride of the input tensor.
No in-place modification; returns a newly allocated tensor.
Computes softmax along dimension 1 over the channel axis.
Output dtype is torch.float32 on cuda:0.
Stable numerical computation using max subtraction.
Clamps each element of softmax output to [-1, 1].
No additional arguments are supplied, so defaults min_val=-1.0, max_val=1.0, inplace=False are used.
Returns the hardtanh output tensor as the final result.
